Actions.Name: Type Clipboard
Actions.Tooltip: Reads your clipboard and types it out keystroke-by-keystroke. Perfect for remote consoles (iLO, iDRAC, KVM) that don't support paste.

Author: fullmetalfred
Description: Type your clipboard contents via simulated keystrokes. Built for sysadmins who need to paste into remote consoles that don't support clipboard.
Name: ClipType
